ambient_events: Somebody stops on the kerb to retie a shoe.
A street sweeper goes by on Sorrel Way with its brushes up.
A sparrow lands on the kerb, finds nothing and goes.
description: A square of lawn between the Recital Hall and 4 Sorrel Way, with benches round a lamp and a bin. A folded concert programme stops one bench rocking.
name: Sorrel Gardens
